instruction: This environment provides three candidate engineering applications, including BIM-capable applications and a distractor application. Choose an appropriate BIM-capable application yourself. Seed create workshop with storage. Open the provided seed IFC from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in the selected BIM application before editing. The seed file is only a simple editable starting reference; keep useful existing geometry, but it is acceptable to redraw simple walls, floors, rooms, doors, windows, roofs, stairs, columns, or beams with native tools in the selected BIM application if that is faster. Create a one-storey workshop layout with two named rooms, Workshop and Store. Add a partition, one slab, two doors, and one exterior window. This task focuses on a small practical room program. Create real BIM model elements rather than visual-only detail geometry. Use the selected BIM application's Room/Zone/Space tool for named rooms so they export as IFC spaces. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using the selected BIM application's built-in IFC export. Use IFC4 if the export dialog asks for a setup, and enable room or space export if that option is available. The exported IFC should contain IfcSpace rooms named Workshop, Store; at least 1 building storeys, at least 5 wall elements, at least 1 slabs, at least 2 doors, at least 1 windows. Other dimensions, exact coordinates, materials, family type names, wall thicknesses, and harmless metadata may vary.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
